cartoon-audio-short.description: Flat 2D bean-head cartoon characters with plum outlines in a colourful 3D world with black ink outlines, painted textures, depth-of-field and gliding cameras. The output is a vertical 1080x1920 cartoon short at 30 fps, exactly as long as the voiceover, with music and SFX at half the voice level.
best_use_cases: Animated cartoon Shorts and story videos
Voiceover-driven shorts where the picture is timed to the voice
cartoon-audio-short.style: Cartoon-audio-short — flat 2D bean-head characters in a colourful 3D world, ink outlines, painted textures

deep-dive.description: Real stylized 3D explainers rendered in three.js: sculpted people in warm sunlit sets, glowing x-ray cutaways and camera journeys through blood vessels, with shallow focus and a camera that never stops moving. Curious, shocking and satisfying.
best_use_cases: What happens if...? explainers about the human body
Showing what happens inside the body with x-ray cutaways
deep-dive.style: Faceless-shorts — real 3D three.js, warm sunlit sets, cyan x-ray cutaways, deep-red macro body interiors

inside-out.description: A simple flat hero with x-ray cutaways into the body, organs and props as clean vector shapes, bold 1-3 word captions with one yellow word, and a cut every 1-3 seconds with the camera always moving. Curious, slightly shocking and satisfying.
best_use_cases: What happens if...? flat 2D body explainers
Quick-cut Shorts about swallowing, holding breath and other body curiosities
inside-out.style: Faceless-shorts — flat 2D vector, x-ray cyan and danger red on warm cream, bold short captions

night-file.description: Quiet, uneasy, investigative 3D: dark places with one light source, faceless people, witnesses near-black with a thin red rim light and the story subject glowing solid red. Typewriter dates and captions, evidence inserts, film grain and a slow camera.
best_use_cases: Documented cold cases told with evidence inserts
night-file.style: Faceless-shorts — dark 3D, one light source, red subject glow, typewriter captions, film grain

paper-atlas.description: History told in cut paper: every shape is cut paper on aged parchment with a light paper edge and soft drop shadow, maps with crimson routes, gold date ribbons, wax seals and simple period figures. Storybook, curious and grand.
best_use_cases: History stories told through maps and places
Documented events like fires and disasters, told with objects and consequences
paper-atlas.style: Faceless-shorts — cut paper on aged parchment, crimson routes, gold date ribbons, wax seals

stick-story.description: Black stick people whose big white eyes do the acting, in flat illustrated rooms in day and night versions, with gold numbered step cards and one picture per clause. Tense, clever and a little funny.
best_use_cases: What would you do if...? survival-step Shorts
Practical safety advice in clear numbered steps
Scenario explainers with a light, funny tone
stick-story.style: Faceless-shorts — black stick figures with big white eyes, flat illustrated rooms, gold step cards

tall-tale.description: Flat 2D cartoon people with thick ink outlines, big round white heads and bean bodies acting inside a sunny, saturated 3D world of small-town streets, shops, meadows and trains. Playful, clever and a little cheeky, with the camera moving in every shot.
best_use_cases: Light-hearted documented anecdotes with expressive characters
Playful cartoon Shorts with word-by-word captions
tall-tale.style: Faceless-shorts — flat 2D toon people in a sunny saturated 3D world, thick ink outlines

clean-tech.description: A calm, bright product-explainer look: cool off-white with a drifting dot grid, crisp words that rise into place, white UI cards with soft shadows, one electric blue accent and mono labels. Short statements rise word by word and ideas become small working diagrams.
best_use_cases: Explaining a workflow or tool with small working diagrams
clean-tech.style: AI video editor, Kinetic Type — cool off-white, dot grid, electric blue accent, rising kinetic type

software-walkthrough.description: A polished screen-recording tutorial built entirely in code: an app window on a soft gradient desktop, a real-feeling cursor with click ripples, a camera that zooms into what matters, yellow-edged spotlights and numbered step callouts. It shows the clicks, not just the idea.
best_use_cases: Showing a real app flow step by step with the cursor
Screen-and-UI explainers that end on the result happening
software-walkthrough.style: AI video editor, Screen and UI — coded app window, cursor with click ripples, zoom camera, step callouts

warm-canvas.description: A calm, editorial creator edit built around your own footage: full-frame talking head with clean serif captions, then a warm off-white canvas with a soft swoosh where white cards explain the idea while you shrink into a rounded picture-in-picture. Fraunces headlines in ink and sky blue with quiet UI text and pastel chips.
best_use_cases: Talking-head creator videos with visual explanations
Explaining an idea with cards, tables and takeaway pills beside the speaker
Editorial explainer edits built on A-roll footage
warm-canvas.style: AI video editor, Talking Head — warm off-white canvas, Fraunces headlines, picture-in-picture speaker

crosshatch.description: A sketchy ink line that boils on 2s, with crosshatch and coloured-pencil shading clipped inside shapes, stipple and paper grain. Warm cream paper and wood by day, and navy inside-the-computer worlds with periwinkle lines and glowing accents.
best_use_cases: Stories set inside a computer or a technical world
crosshatch.style: cth-animate — sketchy boiling ink line, crosshatch and coloured-pencil shading on cream paper

cut-paper.description: Torn-edge paper shapes with soft drop shadows, paper grain and crayon in the fills, patterns like stripes, dots and gingham, full-bleed colour worlds and characters with simple faces. Collage-style animation that is playful, warm and busy with small life.
best_use_cases: Warm, craft-like explainers with patterned paper worlds
Character stories in a handmade paper look
cut-paper.style: cth-animate — torn-edge cut paper, crayon fills, patterns, soft shadows on cream

isometric.description: Calm, precise product illustration: objects in 2:1 dimetric isometric on a white ground, drawn only with constant hairlines. Grey silhouettes and edges, lighter inner lines, white-filled faces, rounded slabs with visible thickness and one tiny dark accent per frame.
best_use_cases: Precise technical illustrations of devices and parts
isometric.style: cth-animate — isometric line art, constant hairlines on white, one tiny dark accent

math.description: A manim-style math explainer look: coloured math on a near-black stage, with serif type written on, axes and graphs swept-drawn, equations transforming into each other and a tracking dot with a live decimal readout. Clean vector strokes where the colour coding does the work.
best_use_cases: Math explainers: formulas, proofs, functions and rates
Ideas with a picture, like a geometric fact
Rigorous explainers where the math on screen must be true
math.style: cth-animate — manim-style, coloured math on near-black, written serif type, swept graphs

pixel.description: Pixel art drawn at a low internal resolution with whole-pixel primitives in a limited palette, scaled up nearest-neighbour, with hard square pixels, ordered dithering instead of gradients and a built-in bitmap font. Resolution can tell time: an early era is chunkier than a later one.
best_use_cases: Pixel-art explainers where eras get sharper over time
pixel.style: cth-animate — pixel art, low internal resolution scaled nearest-neighbour, Bayer dithering

riso.description: A three-ink risograph print on cream paper: halftone screens at their own angles, overprints instead of mixed colours, plates a few pixels off register and ink dropouts that sparkle in the darks. Flat, bright and a little worn.
best_use_cases: Bright, textured explainers with a risograph feel
Art-led stories with flat colour and halftone
riso.style: cth-animate — three-ink risograph on cream, halftone screens, off-register overprints

sketchbook.description: Graphite and one accent colour on a warm sketchbook page, where every line is drawn by hand and boils on 2s. Things get pencilled in, inked over, then coloured with a quick scribble, and hand lettering on the page does the narrating.
best_use_cases: Ideas sketched out live on the page
Personal, sketchy stories with hand lettering
sketchbook.style: cth-animate — graphite and terracotta on a warm sketchbook page, boiling hand-drawn lines

breakdown.description: A 3D exploded-view animation for a reel: a phone floats on a dark studio backdrop and comes apart layer by layer, glass, screen, frame, board, battery and back, with each part getting a thin leader line and a label. Use for an exploded view, a what-is-inside teardown or a labelled 3D breakdown of a device.
best_use_cases: Exploded-view teardowns of a phone or device
What is inside explainers with labelled parts
breakdown.style: Artem — 3D exploded view, dark studio backdrop, leader lines and labels

dan-koe.description: Dan Koe style minimal black-and-white line art for a reel: one white dot on pure black grows into a hairline tree that splits in two at every step, the tips light up, a pulse ring and sparks go off, and one quiet lowercase line swaps to a second. Use for calm black-and-white motion graphics about choices, habits or compounding.
best_use_cases: Calm black-and-white motion graphics about choices and habits
Minimal line-art reels with one moving dot
dan-koe.style: Artem — minimal black-and-white line art, hairline branching tree, one white dot

graph.description: A minimal line-graph animation for a reel: a smooth black line draws itself on white, or white on black, while one big number counts up with the tip, then lands on the final value. Use for a growth chart, a 0 to 100K number animation or an animated stat.
best_use_cases: Simple follower or revenue count-up reels
graph.style: Artem — minimal line graph, counting number riding the line tip, black on white

kurzgesagt.description: A Kurzgesagt style flat-vector space explainer shot: deep navy-purple space with twinkling stars, flat planets lit from one side with a dark crescent and a soft glow, bright rounded label tags and a white caption low in the frame. The built-in scene stacks all seven planets, to scale, between Earth and the Moon at its farthest.
kurzgesagt.style: Artem — Kurzgesagt flat vector, navy-purple space, flat planets with glow and label tags

low-poly.description: A PS1 and N64-era low-poly 3D animation in the style of low poly shorts: chunky low-resolution pixels, wobbly vertices, dithering, flat warm lighting and small yellow captions with a thin black outline. The built-in scene is a train platform where a dog sits and waits as a train brakes in and pulls away.
best_use_cases: Quiet, warm character moments in low poly
low-poly.style: Artem — PS1-era low-poly 3D, chunky pixels, wobbly vertices, flat warm light

map-route.description: A 3D map animation for a reel: a clean white city with parks and a river, a coloured route that draws itself from start to destination while the camera follows, a red pin that drops with a bounce, an ETA card that counts down and a destination card. Use for an animated route, a from-A-to-B map, a journey or a commute.
best_use_cases: Animated routes and journeys on a map
From A to B and commute animations
map-route.style: Artem — 3D white city map, self-drawing coloured route, bouncing red pin, ETA card

minecraft.description: A Minecraft-style blocky voxel animation: a cottage builds itself block by block on a grassy hill, about 165 blocks dropping in with a bounce, then the chimney slams in with a puff of dust, the windows light up warm, smoke rises and a big pixel-font word lands. Procedural 16x16 pixel textures, blocky trees and flat blocky clouds, rendered with three.js.
best_use_cases: Cosy blocky scenes with a payoff word
minecraft.style: Artem — Minecraft voxel, procedural pixel textures, block-by-block cottage build

minimalistic-graphics.description: A minimal black-and-white line-art animation: thin outlined steps rise one by one, a white dot hops up them, and at the top an orbit draws around it and a short second line swaps in. One quiet lowercase line of text sits on top.
best_use_cases: Simple black-and-white motion graphics about progress
Minimal line-art reels with one moving dot
minimalistic-graphics.style: Artem — minimal black-and-white line art, rising outlined steps, hopping white dot

stick-figure.description: A code-animated stick-figure explainer reel, 9:16 and 30 to 45 seconds, from a question or topic: a bright cartoon world with thick outlines, stick people with big white heads and faces, constant camera motion, whip transitions, 1 to 2 word captions and cartoon sound effects, all timed to the voiceover word by word.
best_use_cases: Playful explainer Shorts timed to the voiceover
stick-figure.style: Artem — stick figures with big white heads, bright cartoon world, thick outlines, whip cuts

zach-d-films.description: A 3D cartoon what-if explainer short in the style of Zack D. Films-type videos, entirely in code with three.js: procedural cartoon people, props and effects, a blue studio sky, slow-motion impacts, a red force-ripple overlay, quick whip cuts and 1 to 3 word captions timed to the voiceover.
best_use_cases: Could X stop Y style shorts with characters and props
zach-d-films.style: Artem — 3D cartoon, three.js, blue studio sky, slow-motion impacts, red force ripple

bio-glow.description: Inside the body, built in Three.js: glossy red cells drift down a glowing red vessel toward the camera, with fog for depth, a warm bloom, and clean white labels on thin leader lines. The camera travels down the vessel the whole time while one hero cell gets a label and a big glowing counter climbs.
best_use_cases: Explaining processes inside the human body
Science visuals that travel inside a vessel
bio-glow.style: Nafay, 3D — glossy red cells in a glowing vessel, fog depth, warm bloom

blueprint.description: A technical drawing on blueprint blue: pale line work on a fine grid, dimension lines with arrowheads, a dashed yellow reference line, mono callouts and a title block in the corner, with the mechanism actually moving. The drawing inks itself in, then the mechanism runs and every part reacts the way it really would.
best_use_cases: Technical drawings that move and show cause and effect
blueprint.style: Nafay, Hand-Drawn — blueprint blue, pale line work on a grid, dimension lines, title block

breaking-desk.description: An invented news-desk package over your footage: a LIVE bug with a channel name, a red BREAKING tab, a white headline bar that types itself, a scrolling ticker, a map inset with a pulsing dot, and a clock. The headline types out with a flash and a second headline swaps in with a wipe for the follow-up.
best_use_cases: Headline-driven updates with a map inset
breaking-desk.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — news desk package, LIVE bug, BREAKING tab, typing headline, ticker

callout-kit.description: Hand-drawn annotation tools over your footage: red marker circles that draw themselves, arrows with marker labels, a magnifier box that zooms into a detail with connector lines, a pixelate blur for anything private, and a pulsing spotlight. Each callout draws itself on the beat and clears before the next one.
best_use_cases: Annotating a clip with circles, arrows and zooms
Highlighting one detail at a time over video
callout-kit.style: Nafay, Edit Overlay — hand-drawn red marker callouts, magnifier zoom, spotlight over footage

chalk-talk.description: A teacher at a long green slate: grainy chalk strokes that skip over the board's tooth, colored chalk for emphasis, dust falling from the stick as it writes, faint ghosts of old lessons, a wooden frame and a dusty chalk tray. One continuous lesson along the board, with the camera tracking to the next stretch of slate.
best_use_cases: Teacher-style lessons written on a board
Step-by-step explanations that build along a slate
chalk-talk.style: Nafay, Hand-Drawn — green slate, grainy chalk strokes, coloured chalk emphasis, dust

chat-story.description: A story told through an invented messaging app: a clean header with a gradient avatar and an online dot, teal bubbles for me and white bubbles for them, typing dots before every reply, timestamps, read receipts, and a fictional-story tag. Messages pop in one by one and the thread scrolls up as it fills.
best_use_cases: Suspenseful chat-thread Shorts with a punchline
Dialogue-driven stories in a messaging app
chat-story.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — invented messaging app, teal and white bubbles, typing dots

clay-diorama.description: A soft clay miniature world on a round base, built in Three.js: chunky rounded shapes, warm studio light, a slow orbiting camera and a tilt-shift blur, with cream cards explaining each beat. The diorama pops up piece by piece, then the camera orbits while the idea plays out on the little world.
best_use_cases: Showing a process play out on a tiny clay scene
clay-diorama.style: Nafay, 3D — soft clay miniature on a round base, warm studio light, tilt-shift blur

comic-panels.description: A comic-book page drawn in code: thick black panel borders, halftone dot fills in bright flat colours, round speech balloons, yellow caption boxes, and a big spiky sound-effect burst, with Bangers lettering throughout. The camera reads the page like a reader, zooming panel by panel.
best_use_cases: Stories told panel by panel with speech balloons
comic-panels.style: Nafay, Illustrated — comic page in code, halftone fills, speech balloons, Bangers lettering

cosmic-scale.description: Planets and stars at their true relative sizes in a deep starfield, built in Three.js with textures painted in code, and a camera that pulls back in big log-scale moves to reveal the scale. It starts close on something familiar, then each beat the camera pulls back by a power of ten.
best_use_cases: Showing the true scale of planets and stars
cosmic-scale.style: Nafay, 3D — planets at true relative size in a deep starfield, log-scale pull-backs

creator-motion-graphics.description: The high-energy business-creator edit: huge condensed caps slamming in word by word, a yellow serif accent on the one word that matters, highlighter swipes, hand-drawn circles and arrows, tilted browser and phone mockups, rolling green counters, film grain and light leaks on near-black. Every idea gets its own beat.
best_use_cases: Punchy idea-per-beat explainers with proof mockups
creator-motion-graphics.style: Nafay, Kinetic Type — huge condensed caps, yellow serif accent, mockups, grain on near-black

data-city.description: A 3D bar chart that grows like a city skyline at night, built in Three.js: navy towers with lit windows, glowing cyan-to-magenta roofs, a grid floor fading into fog, and values floating above each tower. Towers rise one by one with their values counting up while the camera slowly circles the skyline.
best_use_cases: Bar-chart data shown as a night skyline
Data stories with a cinematic 3D feel
data-city.style: Nafay, 3D — bar chart as a night city skyline, glowing roofs, fog, circling camera

data-story.description: A calm, editorial data explainer: deep ink background, one warm accent per idea in coral, teal or sand, Archivo headlines, IBM Plex Mono numbers and labels, charts that draw themselves to scale, and the source always on screen. Numbers count up, then shrink into a label as the chart arrives.
best_use_cases: Editorial data explainers with sourced charts
Showing a trend with a line that draws through real data
data-story.style: Nafay, Data — deep ink background, warm accents, self-drawing charts, source on screen

deep-layers.description: A cross-section block of the ground in Three.js, with a tiny house and trees on top and stacked layers of soil, clay, rock and glowing hot rock below. A white drill line pushes down while the camera dives with it, and each layer gets a label as the drill reaches it.
best_use_cases: Cross-section explainers of what lies underground
Depth and layers, from surface to deep rock
deep-layers.style: Nafay, 3D — ground cross-section block, stacked soil and rock layers, diving drill line

doc-cinema.description: Mini-documentary finishing: letterbox bars, heavy film grain, a warm-cool grade, slow Ken Burns push-ins, big serif chapter titles centred in the frame, and a small mono location and date stamp in the corner. Each chapter opens with a slow push-in and the title fading up letter-spaced in the centre.
doc-cinema.style: Nafay, Edit Overlay — letterbox, film grain, warm-cool grade, serif chapter titles

evidence-board.description: A detective corkboard: speckled cork, polaroids with sketched clues, typed index cards, yellow sticky notes, red push pins and red string, with a case-file label taped at the top and a rubber stamp for the verdict. The camera moves across the board clue by clue as red string draws itself from pin to pin.
evidence-board.style: Nafay, Illustrated — detective corkboard, polaroids, red string, verdict stamp

exploded-view.description: A clean studio teardown in Three.js: an object turns slowly on a light grey floor and floats apart into its layers, each part tagged with a numbered mono label on a thin leader line. The closed object turns once, then its layers lift apart one at a time, each named as it moves.
best_use_cases: Studio teardowns of an object layer by layer
Showing what is inside a product
exploded-view.style: Nafay, 3D — clean studio teardown, floating layers, numbered mono labels

glass-icons.description: Glossy translucent 3D app icons in Three.js, floating on a soft mint, sky and peach gradient, each with a white symbol on its face, frosted labels and a crisp black headline. The icons float in from depth into a loose stack, then one at a time an icon swings forward to the centre.
best_use_cases: Presenting a set of apps, tools or features
glass-icons.style: Nafay, 3D — glossy translucent app icons on a mint, sky and peach gradient

glitch-pack.description: A digital-glitch toolkit: RGB-split titles in Anton, horizontal slice displacement, block noise in red and cyan, scanlines, a SYSTEM REBOOT terminal tag and glitch transitions that tear your footage apart and put it back together. The intro title glitches on and resolves crisp.
best_use_cases: Glitchy intros and transitions over footage
glitch-pack.style: Nafay, Edit Overlay — RGB-split glitch titles, slice displacement, scanlines, terminal tag

globe-arcs.description: A dark navy globe made of glowing cyan dots in Three.js, turning slowly in a starfield, with warm amber route arcs that draw themselves between pins and a soft blue atmosphere glow. The globe turns into view, a pin drops at the start, then each route arcs up off the surface and lands on its destination.
best_use_cases: Showing routes and journeys around the world
globe-arcs.style: Nafay, 3D — navy dot globe in a starfield, amber route arcs, atmosphere glow

headline-backdrop.description: Commentary layout: you, cut out with a thick white sticker edge and a soft shadow, standing in front of invented article cards that scroll and tilt behind you, with a yellow marker swipe on the line that matters and a black-and-yellow reaction chip. Article cards slide in and stack behind you.
best_use_cases: Reacting to a story with cards behind you
headline-backdrop.style: Nafay, Edit Overlay — sticker-cutout presenter, scrolling article cards, marker swipe

iso-cutaway.description: An isometric cutaway building in Three.js with an orthographic camera: floors like a doll house, warm wall colours, tiny people, and a sky that goes from night blue to morning warm as a clock chip runs. A clock chip ticks through the day while each floor lights up in turn.
best_use_cases: A day in a building, floor by floor
Showing what happens on each level of a place
iso-cutaway.style: Nafay, 3D — isometric cutaway building, doll-house floors, day-to-night sky

isotype.description: Pictogram statistics in the Isotype tradition: a grid of small grey people icons that pop in row by row, then the share that matters turns coral one by one and regroups into its own block, under one huge number. The crowd fills in first so you feel the size, then the stat colours in person by person.
best_use_cases: Showing a statistic as a crowd of pictograms
isotype.style: Nafay, Data — Isotype pictogram crowd, grey icons turning coral, one huge number

karaoke-subs.description: Clean, readable subtitles for any talking video: a rounded dark glass box in the lower third holding two lines, where the word being spoken sits on a bright green pill, spoken words stay white and upcoming words wait at half opacity. The green pill glides from word to word exactly as each is spoken.
best_use_cases: Adding word-by-word subtitles to a talking video
Making speech easy to follow without sound
Clean caption overlays for any edit
karaoke-subs.style: Nafay, Edit Overlay — dark glass subtitle box, green pill tracking the spoken word

low-poly-atlas.description: Faceted low-poly terrain in warm sunset light, built in Three.js: flat-shaded hills, sand coasts and blue water, with roads, routes and campaign arrows drawing themselves across the land. The camera drifts over the land while a route draws itself from a city and a red campaign arrow marches along it.
best_use_cases: Campaigns and routes drawn over terrain
Map-like history stories in low poly
low-poly-atlas.style: Nafay, 3D — faceted low-poly terrain in sunset light, routes and campaign arrows

lower-thirds.description: A consistent identity kit for interviews and long videos: a name tag with an amber accent bar and dark glass panel, a serif chapter card with a progress row, a social handle bar, and a red subscribe nudge with a bell that rings. Each element has one clean entrance and exit.
best_use_cases: Name tags and chapter cards for interviews
Consistent identity graphics for long videos
lower-thirds.style: Nafay, Edit Overlay — name tag, serif chapter card, handle bar, subscribe nudge

marker-board.description: A clean whiteboard in a grey frame: black, blue, red and green marker doodles that draw themselves stroke by stroke, a visible marker pen following the tip, hand-drawn boxes, arrows, a red circle on the key idea and Caveat side notes. Everything appears by being drawn.
best_use_cases: Diagrams and frameworks sketched stroke by stroke
marker-board.style: Nafay, Hand-Drawn — whiteboard, self-drawing marker doodles, pen following the tip

market-tape.description: A trading-screen explainer on near-black: a scrolling ticker strip of invented symbols, candlesticks that print one by one with a price tag riding the last close, green and red numbers, and a red flash when it breaks. Candles print one by one in an uptrend while the price tag climbs, then the trend breaks.
best_use_cases: Explaining a market rise and crash
Finance explainers with candlesticks and tickers
market-tape.style: Nafay, Data — near-black trading screen, ticker strip, printing candlesticks

math-canvas.description: A dark slate for maths: an equation written in an elegant italic serif, a yellow box and handwritten note on the key term, and a graph whose curve plots itself to scale with a glowing dot and a live value, beside a dashed comparison line. The equation writes on term by term.
best_use_cases: Maths explainers with an equation and a live graph
Comparing two curves and measuring the gap
math-canvas.style: Nafay, Data — dark slate, italic serif equation, self-plotting curve, live value

myth-or-fact.description: A clean debunk Short on pale grey: a white statement card with a big quote mark, then a rubber stamp slams down, red MYTH or green FACT, with distressed ink, followed by one line of proof with a check icon. Each round reads like a game, with a short thinking pause inviting a guess.
myth-or-fact.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — pale grey debunk, statement card, red MYTH or green FACT stamp

neon-line.description: Characters drawn as single continuous glowing neon lines on a deep night-blue wall: one pink, one cyan, with a soft bloom, a flicker when they switch on, neon-script captions, and small glowing props in the same line style. Each character draws itself in one stroke as if a neon tube is lighting up.
best_use_cases: Two-character stories about connection and distance
Romantic or emotional tales in glowing line art
neon-line.style: Nafay, Character Story — single continuous neon lines, pink and cyan on night blue

paper-craft.description: Layered cut paper with real drop shadows and a fibre texture: rolling paper hills, a paper sun, flowers and a striped paper bee, all moving at 12 frames a second like stop-motion, with titles on torn white paper strips. The scene builds itself layer by layer, then a little character travels through it beat by beat.
best_use_cases: Gentle, craft-like journeys with numbered steps
Children's-story and nature tales in paper
paper-craft.style: Nafay, Illustrated — layered cut paper, drop shadows, fibre texture, 12 fps stop-motion feel

parchment-map.description: An aged ink map on stained parchment: hand-inked coastlines with a second faint outline, a graticule, burnt edges, a compass rose, a little sailing ship and a red dashed route that draws itself as the camera follows it across the map. At each key place a typewriter date stamp drops in.
best_use_cases: Journeys and voyages on an old map
History told through a travelling route
parchment-map.style: Nafay, Illustrated — aged parchment map, hand-inked coastlines, red dashed route, compass rose

physics-toybox.description: Bright plastic toys in Three.js on a sunny yellow floor: glossy balls, a white ramp and a curving chain of coloured dominoes that grow in size, with crisp shadows and a slow-motion moment on the key hit. A ball rolls down the ramp and starts a chain reaction you can follow beat by beat.
best_use_cases: Physics chain reactions and domino runs
Showing cause and effect with toys
Playful science demos with slow motion
physics-toybox.style: Nafay, 3D — bright plastic toys on a sunny yellow floor, domino chain, slow motion

pixel-quest.description: Chunky pixel art drawn on a 180 by 320 grid and scaled up 4x: a side-scrolling level with a little hero, sky bands, pixel clouds, brick platforms and gems, under a retro HUD with hearts, an XP bar and a level number, and a dialog box for every tip. The hero walks through the level while the camera scrolls with them.
best_use_cases: Tips presented as a retro game quest
Gamified how-to Shorts with levels and XP
pixel-quest.style: Nafay, Retro — chunky pixel art on a 180x320 grid, side-scrolling level, retro HUD

podcast-clip.description: A vertical podcast clip: two stacked rounded speaker panels on black, host on top and guest below, a green ring on whoever is talking, bold captions in the seam with the key words in yellow, an episode tag and a live waveform at the bottom. Captions appear two to four words at a time in the seam.
podcast-clip.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — stacked speaker panels, active-speaker green ring, seam captions, waveform

pop-info.description: A flat-vector animated infographic, drawn entirely in code: a cosy cartoon scene, one small character with a big feeling, a teal thought bubble that carries the idea, a counter, a dotted path and an iris wipe in and out. Muted room colours, warm product colours and rounded Fredoka type.
best_use_cases: Everyday ideas shown in a cosy cartoon scene
Friendly fact videos with a thought bubble
pop-info.style: Nafay, Illustrated — flat-vector infographic, cosy scene, teal thought bubble, Fredoka type

product-turntable.description: A premium product shot in Three.js: an invented product turning on a glossy dark pedestal with a glowing amber rim, a warm key light and a cool rim light, with thin spec callouts and a big italic serif name. The camera eases in as the product turns and spec callouts pop out one at a time on thin leader lines.
best_use_cases: Presenting a product with spec callouts
Hero product shots with a turning pedestal
product-turntable.style: Nafay, 3D — product on a glossy dark pedestal, amber rim glow, spec callouts

punch-captions.description: High-retention captions over your talking-head clip: one to three words at a time in huge white Anton with a thick black outline, the key word swapped to yellow and tilted, little sticker pops drawn in code, and punch-in zooms on the hits. Captions follow the speech in tiny chunks, each word slamming in.
best_use_cases: Making speech hit harder with zoom and stickers
punch-captions.style: Nafay, Edit Overlay — huge Anton captions, yellow key word, sticker pops, punch zooms

quiz-countdown.description: A loud trivia Short on a bright orange striped background: a white question card, four answer pills with letter badges, a white timer ring that drains around a big countdown number, then a green reveal with confetti. The question card pops in, the answers slide in one by one, and the ring drains while the number counts down.
quiz-countdown.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — bright orange trivia, question card, four answers, draining timer ring

quote-cinema.description: A quiet cinematic quote card: deep warm black, a slow drifting light leak, heavy film grain and a slow push-in, with a quote that sets word by word in a large serif, one key word in warm italic, and a tracked author line. The frame breathes as the quote fades up one word at a time.
best_use_cases: Words of wisdom with a filmic feel
quote-cinema.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — deep warm black, drifting light leak, film grain, large serif quote

recipe-steps.description: A top-down cooking Short on a warm wooden table: food and tools drawn in code from above, bowl, pan and plate, ingredient chips that drop in, a dark step card with a big step number, and a timer ring that drains for each step. The ingredients drop onto the table first, then each step swaps the scene from above.
recipe-steps.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — top-down cooking on wood, ingredient chips, step card, timer ring

rubber-hose-reel.description: A 1930s black-and-white cartoon: an original rubber-hose character with noodle limbs, pie-cut eyes and white gloves bouncing on the beat, on a grey painted set, with film flicker, dust, scratches, a gate weave and art-deco title cards. The whole short bounces to the music.
best_use_cases: Musical gag Shorts in three beats
rubber-hose-reel.style: Nafay, Character Story — 1930s black-and-white rubber hose, noodle limbs, film flicker

shadow-puppets.description: A shadow-puppet theatre: jointed black silhouette puppets on visible rods, pressed against a warm backlit paper screen that glows and flickers like a flame, with cut-out scenery, a wooden stage frame and fable lines in an elegant serif. Puppets slide in on their rods and act with simple jointed moves.
shadow-puppets.style: Nafay, Character Story — black silhouette puppets on rods, backlit paper screen, serif fable lines

size-lineup.description: Things lined up smallest to biggest on an endless pale floor with a grid, built in Three.js, while the camera glides past and pulls back. Each one gets a dimension line and a dark height tag, and the final pull-back shows the whole lineup with the giant at the end.
best_use_cases: Showing scale across objects or creatures
size-lineup.style: Nafay, 3D — smallest-to-biggest lineup on a pale grid floor, dimension lines, height tags

stack-split.description: The retention split: your clip on the top half, a satisfying loop drawn in code on the bottom half, kinetic sand being sliced into rainbow layers, and a white caption bar in the seam that carries the story line by line. The top half plays your storytime clip while the bottom loops something calm and satisfying.
best_use_cases: Storytime clips with a satisfying loop below
Talking stories paired with calming visuals
stack-split.style: Nafay, Edit Overlay — split screen, story clip on top, kinetic sand loop below, seam captions

sticker-pop.description: A cosy scrapbook layer over your vlog: die-cut stickers with thick white borders, a title pill, stars, hearts and a coffee cup, striped washi tape on the corners and a lined paper note with handwriting, all popping in with a wobble. Stickers slap on in rhythm with what you say.
best_use_cases: Cosy sticker layers over talking clips
Playful vlog decorations that pop in on the beat
sticker-pop.style: Nafay, Edit Overlay — scrapbook stickers with white borders, washi tape, handwritten note

storybook.description: A picture book on cream watercolour paper: soft washes that bloom in layer by layer, thin brown ink lines that draw the character, gold ink stars, and an italic serif storyline that appears word by word, with page-turn transitions. Each page paints itself.
best_use_cases: Gentle watercolour tales with page turns
Storytime visuals for children and fables
storybook.style: Nafay, Illustrated — cream watercolour paper, blooming washes, brown ink lines, gold stars

swiss-grid.description: International Typographic Style in motion: a strict six-column grid, one huge number, solid red, black and blue geometric blocks, flush-left Inter in black, and small caps labels, all snapping into place with precise wipes. Blocks wipe in along the grid and the big number counts up digit by digit.
swiss-grid.style: Nafay, Kinetic Type — Swiss grid, six columns, huge number, red black and blue blocks

synth-grid.description: A retro neon world: a magenta wireframe landscape scrolling toward you in Three.js under a striped sunset sun, purple sky, chrome-gradient titles with a pink glow and a cyan marker script. The grid races toward the camera the whole time.
synth-grid.style: Nafay, 3D — magenta wireframe landscape, striped sunset sun, chrome titles, purple sky

tactics-board.description: A top-down pitch with mown stripes and crisp white lines, red and blue numbered player tokens with soft shadows, dashed run arrows that draw themselves, a yellow ball path with numbered passes, and a running clock chip. Players move between real positions as the play unfolds.
best_use_cases: Explaining a sports play or tactic
Top-down pitch diagrams with moving players
Match analysis with passes and runs
tactics-board.style: Nafay, Data — top-down pitch, red and blue player tokens, dashed run arrows, clock chip

terminal.description: A glowing green-on-black terminal: typed commands with a block cursor, dim grey output, red and amber warnings, an ASCII progress bar and ASCII box diagrams, with scanlines, a soft phosphor glow and a dark vignette. The story is a terminal session, with a command typing itself and output scrolling out line by line.
best_use_cases: Tech stories told as a terminal session
terminal.style: Nafay, Retro — green-on-black terminal, block cursor, ASCII diagrams, scanlines

tier-list.description: A classic tier-list board on dark charcoal: S to D rows with bright rainbow labels, rounded item tiles with simple icons drawn in code, and a stash of unranked tiles at the bottom that fly up one by one. Each item leaves the stash, hangs for a moment with its name, then arcs into its tier.
best_use_cases: Ranking items from S to D
Opinion and debate videos with a board
tier-list.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — dark charcoal tier board, S to D rainbow rows, flying item tiles

timeline-rail.description: A deep green page with a cream vertical rail: glowing year nodes, cream event cards with a big gold year and a small drawn icon, and a running year odometer in the corner, as the camera scrolls down through time. As it reaches each year the node lights up and the card drops in.
best_use_cases: History told year by year down a rail
timeline-rail.style: Nafay, Data — deep green page, cream vertical rail, glowing year nodes, odometer

top-5-countdown.description: A countdown Short on deep navy: a huge outlined rank number slams in beside an illustrated card drawn in code, with the name in tall Anton caps, a mono detail line, and a ladder of rank dots on the side that tracks where you are. Each rank gets its own beat, and number one gets a bigger hit and a glow.
best_use_cases: Ranked lists with a punch per rank
top-5-countdown.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — deep navy countdown, huge outlined rank number, Anton caps

versus-split.description: A head-to-head Short: the screen splits diagonally into coral and blue halves that slam in from the sides, a black VS badge with a yellow ring, two characters drawn in code, and stat bars that race toward each other row by row with a winner crown. Both sides slide in and collide, then each stat row runs.
versus-split.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — diagonal coral and blue split, VS badge, racing stat bars

vhs-camcorder.description: A home-video camcorder overlay on your footage: a blocky white PLAY or REC readout, a blinking red dot, a battery icon, a date and time stamp, a tracking-noise band that rolls through, chroma bleed, a warm faded grade and scanlines. Your clip plays as if recorded on tape.
vhs-camcorder.style: Nafay, Edit Overlay — VHS camcorder overlay, REC readout, tracking band, chroma bleed

visual-novel.description: A visual-novel scene: a soft, blurred painted background, a large original anime-style character bust drawn in code with big glossy eyes, swapping expressions like smile, nervous sweat, shocked and laughing with blush, and a translucent dialogue box with a name tag and typewriter text. The story is told as dialogue.
visual-novel.style: Nafay, Character Story — anime character bust, big glossy eyes, dialogue box, typewriter text

woodcut-tale.description: A two-colour woodcut print come to life: cream paper, bold black ink shapes with white carved hatching inside them, a red second colour slightly out of register, ink speckle and paper grain, with old-style serif captions in a carved border. Each scene is a print, moving at a stiff 8 frames a second like a printed flipbook.
best_use_cases: Printed flipbook stories with a moral
Historical tales in a two-colour print look
woodcut-tale.style: Nafay, Character Story — two-colour woodcut, black ink with carved hatching, red out of register

zine-collage.description: A DIY zine on kraft paper: torn pink and black paper, halftone cutouts drawn in code, ransom-note letters each in a different font and colour, translucent tape strips and handwritten notes, all slapped on at a jittery 8 frames a second. Pieces are slapped onto the page one after another like someone building a collage live.
zine-collage.style: Nafay, Illustrated — DIY zine on kraft paper, torn paper, ransom-note letters, tape
